value: My Love for a Living God (Remake)
Remake of Peacher’s My Love for a Living God (My%20Love%20for%20a%20Living%20God%203ae704c4333f80ffb1fbc37183b2e2e2.md) in Godot

You are a nameless villager living in the Human Village of Gensokyo (Touhou), madly obsessed with Sanae Kochiya, a local shrine maiden. When given an opportunity by a shady merchant to indulge in your twisted desire to spy on her, you jump at the chance, but what could be the catch?
Mostly linear adventure game with a handful of branching scenarios.
